520:t_2:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's why I want to open my heart and reveal my true intentions to gain your cooperation.」

520:t_2:56.en:
$n
「You must think very little of us.」

520:t_2:57.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Is there another one here who doesn't know how to speak properly?」

520:t_2:58.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Stop, $$アンジェロ$$. Their tempers must be running high right now.」

520:t_2:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, let them rest after their long journey. The meeting will be in six hours.」

520:t_2:60.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I understand. Until then, I'll detain the members of $c.」

520:t_2:61.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Make sure you treat them courteously.」

520:t_2:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For now, we have no choice but to follow their instructions.」

520:t_2:64.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's good. You've finally understood your position.」

520:t_2:65.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Thank you for answering my call, Captain.」

520:t_2:67.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You've given us information several times before. Were you waiting for a decisive opportunity?」

520:t_2:69.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Or were you unable to make up your mind, putting off your decision until today...」

520:t_2:71.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Did it feel empty...? Did nursing a grudge you could never settle become empty, making you dream of another possibility...?」

520:t_2:72.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Was it the light of human hearts that enveloped $$アクシズ$$, $c, and that boy, $$バナージ・リンクス$$...? Or Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$...?」

520:t_2:73.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...It's true that the grudges we carry can't be settled no matter what we do. But that's not quite the same as feeling empty...」

520:t_2:74.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I suppose I got tired... of the person I'd become, giving up on everything and huddling in the dark...」

520:t_2:75.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Maybe that man... $$シャア・アズナブル$$, who wanted to open the $$ニュータイプ$$ world his father dreamed of rather than take revenge on the $$ザビ家$$, too...」

520:t_2:76.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I sometimes think... he felt the same way I do now...」

520:t_2:78.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「One thing is certain: this will guide events in a favorable direction. Thank you for your cooperation, Captain.」

520:t_2:83.en: ～Inside the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　Medical Facility～

520:t_2:85.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

520:t_2:86.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I see... So I've been asleep ever since the return trip...」

520:t_2:89.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ is currently occupied by $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:90.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Did Master guide them here...?」

520:t_2:92.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I wasn't certain... And I wanted to believe in Master...」

520:t_2:93.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That... brought about an irreversible outcome... I'm sorry...」

520:t_2:94.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Please don't blame yourself, $$マリーダ$$... I... felt the same way.」

520:t_2:96.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've... fought in the $$ユニコーン$$ up until today, but maybe it was all pointless...」

520:t_2:97.en:
$$バナージ$$
「When I think that if I'd quietly given the Box to $$ネオ・ジオン$$, the fighting might have ended, one way or another, and the world might have been at peace...」

520:t_2:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...'But,' 'even so'... Everything I did with those thoughts has backfired... No matter how much I struggle, it's already...」

520:t_2:101.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But thanks to that, I'm here talking to you now...」

520:t_2:103.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The way you feel isn't wrong.」

520:t_2:104.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Believe in the possibilities within yourself... Give your all to what you feel you must do...」

520:t_2:105.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Those words aren't a curse. The person who told you that must have lived that way, too, without any certainty, just believing it was for the best.」

520:t_2:106.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... that's irresponsible when he hasn't even seen it through himself...」

520:t_2:108.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But, even so... Entrusting it to someone who wasn't a stranger was the greatest blessing of all.」

520:t_2:109.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm sure that's how the world moves forward little by little, if we keep hoping without giving up or letting ourselves be trapped.」

520:t_2:111.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Your chance will come. When it does, get in the $$ガンダム$$ without hesitation.」

520:t_2:116.en: ～Inside the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　Briefing Room～

520:t_2:117.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...I'm pleased to have the opportunity to talk with you all face-to-face like this.」

520:t_2:120.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, allow me to introduce myself again. I'm $$フル・フロンタル$$, leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:123.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Why have you gathered us here, $$フロンタル$$?」

520:t_2:124.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As I said in the dock, I want to ask all of you to cooperate, including those who defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:125.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're serious about joining forces with us?」

520:t_2:126.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's correct. To that end, I want you to understand what I'm aiming for.」

520:t_2:127.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And that wish extends to him, too.」

520:t_2:128.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Come in, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_2:131.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... We're reunited under these circumstances.」

520:t_2:132.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「How pathetic you are. So you suffered the disgrace of captivity after all.」

520:t_2:133.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's not so, $$ハマーン$$. He could become the person who understands me best.」

520:t_2:134.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's why I want to speak my true intentions here, with $c, who are distancing him from being $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_2:135.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that's the settlement you spoke of...」

520:t_2:136.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I agree, Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

520:t_2:138.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if you obtain $$ラプラスの箱$$, I don't believe you intend to restore $$ジオン$$ under the Empire.」

520:t_2:139.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Here and now, I will hear your true intentions.」
